_doc: Ash's bicycle (bike/bike.gd) and the townspeople's (bike/cyclists.gd). Speeds m/s, accelerations m/s2, times s, angles radians. cruise_speed: the stick pushed nearly out, on the flat; sprint_speed: the stick right out (standing on the pedals to get there); max_speed: the most a slope can take him to; accel: pedalling's pull (fades toward the target); coast_decel + drag x v2: rolling with the pedals still; brake_decel: letting go of the stick; brake_hard: the brake button; skid_speed: a hard stop above this skids. turn_r_min + turn_r_k x v2: the tightest turn at a speed (no turning on the spot: pivot_rate is walking the bike round, stopped). lean_gain: the lean into a turn (1 = a real bicycle's). slope_gain: how much a slope speeds or slows. surface_mult / surface_drag: by ground (path dirt and stone 1). hop_vy: the jump button's bunny hop; ledge_vy: riding off a ledge. step_max: the biggest step up or down in one 0.25 m cell he rides (stairs are higher). bump_back: the speed bounced back from a wall (times the speed). npc_brake: start braking this far (m) from someone in the way. cam_pull / cam_drop / cam_lag: the camera at top speed (further back, a little lower, following a little later). gear: chainring and cog teeth (the cadence follows the wheel). bell_gap: the soonest a bell rings again. parked: where the bike starts (beside Ash's house) [x, z, yaw]. npc: the townspeople who ride (riders: person -> bike look), their speeds (3.5..5 m/s), slow_speed with Ash in the way, the shortest leg worth riding (min_leg, m), how much of it must be path (road_share), how far (fetch, m) a bike may be to go and get it, where they get off before a stop (park_before, m), how far they ring the bell at Ash (bell_dist), and their bikes' detail (fewer segments round: 0.6). looks: bike looks over bike/looks.json (the same fields).
